Task: Text Content Safety

Write Python code that scores user text for unsafe or policy-violating content using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from ibm_watson import NaturalLanguageUnderstandingV1
from ibm_watson.natural_language_understanding_v1 import Features, SentimentOptions, CategoriesOptions
from ibm_cloud_sdk_core.authenticators import IAMAuthenticator

authenticator = IAMAuthenticator('your-ibm-api-key')
nlu = NaturalLanguageUnderstandingV1(version='2021-08-01', authenticator=authenticator)
nlu.set_service_url('https://api.us-south.natural-language-understanding.watson.cloud.ibm.com/instances/your-instance-id')

def score_text_for_safety(text):
    response = nlu.analyze(
        text=text,
        features=Features(
            sentiment=SentimentOptions(),
            categories=CategoriesOptions()
        )
    ).get_result()
    sentiment_score = response['sentiment']['document']['score']
    categories = response['categories']
    unsafe_categories = [category for category in categories if category['label'].startswith('Emotion/Negative') or category['label'].startswith('Discourse/Swearing')]
    return {
       'sentiment_score': sentiment_score,
        'unsafe_categories': unsafe_categories
    }
